content: Sometimes the rules tell you to divide a number in half. Whenever you divide an odd number in half and it results in a decimal, round the result down to the nearest whole number. For instance, if a [tactician](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/tactician) takes 7 damage and uses the Parry ability in response—a [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) that halves the damage—then the damage is reduced to 3.
name: Always Round Down
